protocol_amendment_scope: API pagination/chunk semantics, stricter temporal LOSO, scheduler replay identifiability, minimum cluster diversity, synthetic correlated-risk sensitivity, correction of TLE-churn claim, direct paired ablations, bounded same-pass TLE matching, crossed multi-asset optimizer verification, station-cluster temporal sensitivity with an evaluated-cluster gate, fail-closed malformed-demoddata handling, a single confirmatory-comparison hierarchy, explicit indeterminate TLE matching, asymmetric artifact-qualified conditional-decode labels, timestamp-atomic temporal boundaries, and exclusion of retrieval-time station coordinates from probability features in favor of observation-cached schedule geometry; no real-cohort model fitted or real-cohort performance metric inspected (synthetic integration smoke and partial label-count/schema QA only)

protocol_amendments.scope: API pagination/chunk semantics, stricter temporal LOSO, and scheduler replay identifiability guard

Require at least five satellite and station clusters in the conditional-decode task so its cluster-bootstrap interval is identifiable; added after partial acquisition QA but before any model fit or performance metric
Add two declared station-day/satellite-day/environment-day correlated-risk engineering scenarios to the synthetic monthly robustness artifact; this does not use cohort outcomes and is not a forecast
Correct the TLE analysis claim from unobservable selected-plan churn to observable material replan-trigger counts and freeze-horizon proxy counts
Add direct paired full-vs-geometry and full-vs-group Brier ablations in temporal, held-satellite and held-station splits; same 5% and upper-CI-below-zero usefulness rule

Require older/newer TLE predictions to match the observed job midpoint within 20 minutes so an adjacent orbit cannot be misclassified as the same pass; added before any model fit or performance inspection

Add an independent exhaustive exactness benchmark for crossed station/satellite conflicts alongside weighted interval DP; added before any real-cohort model fit or real-cohort metric inspection, after synthetic integration smoke

Add station-cluster sensitivity for temporal baseline/ablation comparisons and require at least five evaluated clusters for any usefulness flag; added before any real-cohort model fit or real-cohort metric inspection

Treat missing/non-list demoddata on a confirmed-signal packet observation as a counted malformed-row exclusion rather than a negative decode label; added after partial label-count/schema QA and before any normalized real-cohort build, model fit, or performance inspection

Declare temporal signal-present full-logit versus global-rate as the sole confirmatory comparison and all decode/transfer/station-cluster/alternative/ablation intervals as secondary sensitivity analyses without a multiplicity claim; added before any real-cohort model fit or performance inspection

Report transitions where neither older nor reference TLE yields a same-pass match as indeterminate_unmatched_both rather than implicitly immaterial; added before any real-cohort normalization, TLE result inspection, model fit, or performance inspection

For packet modes, qualify decode positives by a non-empty demoddata artifact even with unknown waterfall, require with-signal plus an explicit empty list for negatives, and exclude without-signal plus positive artifact as contradictory; added after partial label-count/schema QA and before normalized cohort build, model fit, or performance inspection

Keep all observations sharing an exact start timestamp on the same side of temporal and forward-validation boundaries, and independently audit holdout membership/counts/time bounds; added before normalized cohort build, real-cohort model fit, or performance inspection

Use the observation-cached max-altitude and rise/set-azimuth fields for probability features and exclude retrieval-time station coordinates plus coordinate-derived range/Doppler after upstream source inspection showed the API serializer returns current ground_station coordinates; all four cached geometry fields were schema-counted only, no model or performance result was inspected

selection_rule: Active packet-capable transmitter with non-trivial Network transmitter-level good/bad counts; no feature/outcome relationship inspected.
